identity.worldRole: The readable standard zombie of the horde: a fair baseline pressure unit that lets players judge route, damage and defensive choices without borrowing the wall-breaking silhouette of a brute.
identity.manufactureContext: A stylized undead body transformed by a stable violet frontier bloom. Biology is always primary; sparse hardened growth expresses hostile adaptation without player-built armor, copper repair authorship or mechanical chassis language.
identity.emotionalIntent: Immediately recognizable as a zombie, lightly unsettling and tenacious with a touch of awkward physical absurdity, but never realistic, graphic, tragic or gore-dependent.
identity.technologyLevel: undead biological threat with hardened frontier growth
identity.territoryVisualThesis: A memorable violet frontier zombie whose visible face, head-led hunch, unequal open hands and broken-crown biological bloom oppose the fortress's calm construction grammar while remaining instantly readable in a horde.

instantRead.oneSecondPromise: A hunched violet zombie with a visible face, reaching unequal arms and a broken-crown shoulder bloom advances toward the fortress and shows weakening through posture before color.
instantRead.orientationCue: The bowed zombie head, dark face cavity, forward jaw and reaching arm lead the hunched body; the violet bloom sweeps from one side of the crown toward the opposite shoulder and never reads as a visor.
instantRead.interactionCue: No friendly socket, complete ring, service panel or repair affordance exists; the face and hands are target cues, not interaction controls.
instantRead.dangerCue: A forward cranial profile, open reaching hands, bent pursuit posture and a short pre-swipe draw-back communicate attack intent without giant fists or weapon props.
instantRead.relationToPlayer: A hostile but fair baseline zombie whose facing, swipe preparation, stagger and collapse support immediate recognition, causal combat reading and honest post-failure understanding.
responsibleElements: bowed zombie head with dark face cavity and graphic jaw
one reaching forearm and one lower dragging forearm

The bowed zombie head, dark face cavity, forward jaw and reaching arm lead the hunched body; the violet bloom sweeps from one side of the crown toward the opposite shoulder and never reads as a visor.
No friendly socket, complete ring, service panel or repair affordance exists; the face and hands are target cues, not interaction controls.
A forward cranial profile, open reaching hands, bent pursuit posture and a short pre-swipe draw-back communicate attack intent without giant fists or weapon props.

proportionRules: The hunched pear-shaped torso occupies roughly forty-two percent of total height and remains narrower than a brute.
The cranial mass occupies sixteen to twenty percent of total height and projects forward by roughly fifteen percent of body depth.
Arms are thick enough for horde readability but hands remain medium, open and smaller than the head so the unit never promises wall-breaking force.
Bent legs occupy roughly one third of total height and preserve a clear gap between the feet at mobile distance.
The asymmetrical violet bloom stays inside the two-and-a-half-stud width and cannot become a horn, backpack, armor plate or second head.

views.front: A clearly undead violet rôdeur with a bowed visible head, dark expressive face cavity, hunched pear torso, unequal reaching arms and bent separated legs.
views.back: A continuous biological back and one oblique hardened violet bloom reveal the same hunched anatomy without service boxes, armor chassis or invented machinery.
views.left: The forward skull, jaw, rounded upper back and one lower dragging forearm create an unmistakable shambling zombie profile.
views.right: The counter-profile preserves the head-led hunch while the shorter reaching arm and shoulder bloom explain controlled asymmetry.
views.top: The head, hunched spine and hands form a compact forward arrow through pose, while the body itself remains rounded and biological rather than wedge-armored.
views.bottom: Two broad simplified feet, bent ankle connections and a stable animation footprint remain readable and compatible with the feet-center pivot.
views.threeQuarterFront: The canonical read combines visible zombie face, forward cranial hood, hunched violet body, one reaching hand, one lower dragging hand and the oblique shoulder bloom.
views.threeQuarterBack: The rounded spine, asymmetric bloom path, bent legs and hanging arms remain anatomically compatible with the front view and contain no mechanical invention.
views.gameCamera: At horde scale the unit reads as one purple shambling zombie token: head-led, hunched, open-handed and visibly stateful without surface noise.

artDirection.territoryThesis: A hopeful fortress culture of intelligent survival: calm standardized chassis make every tool dependable, while one or two visible adaptations turn scarcity, repair and shared history into proud authorship without post-apocalyptic noise.
shapeGrammar: large protected apertures and explicit load-bearing joints
one localized offset brace or replacement module
visible replacement, reinforcement, sealing or rerouting logic
artDirection.exaggeration: Function, load paths, service access and the single authored adaptation are enlarged enough to read on mobile; distress, dirt and tiny mechanics never carry identity.
artDirection.edgeLanguage: Large consistent structural bevels create calm readable highlights; only the boundary of an approved repair may use a sharper cut or visibly renewed edge, and nothing becomes razor-thin.
artDirection.detailDensity: Low secondary construction density and extremely low tertiary density; seventy-two percent primary mass, twenty-three percent functional secondary structure and five percent causal finish.
artDirection.asymmetry: Twenty-four-percent controlled asymmetry expresses adaptation inside a seventy-five-to-eighty-five-percent standardized chassis; footprint, facing, collision promise, pivots and gameplay anchors remain fixed.
artDirection.materialLanguage: Deep coated structure, reclaimed composite panels, exposed durable metal, matte contacts and rare contextual wood surround carefully protected interaction technology.
artDirection.paletteLogic: Deep slate and bone-sand create a quiet frontier base; sun-baked copper identifies player intervention, while mint interaction, raspberry threat, gold warning and red critical remain bounded semantic roles.
artDirection.surfaceTreatment: Broad calm planes, one or two patch boundaries and directional abrasion tell a construction history without uniform grime, material roulette or photoreal texture chatter.
artDirection.wearLogic: Every scar must name a cause: prior impact, heat, hand contact, ground abrasion or an approved repair operation; damage widens one causal chain and repair reverses it.
